items.title: File Einspruch against the 2023 income tax assessment
items.quote: Einzulegen ist er innerhalb eines Monats seit der Bekanntgabe – schriftlich, elektronisch oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 06.12.2024, sent by ordinary post from the tax office (Finanzamt), so § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (as applicable to this 2024 letter, before the 2025 amendment) applies: it counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 3rd day after posting, i.e. Mon 09.12.2024 (as the letter itself states: 'der dritte Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post'). That day is not a weekend/holiday, so it stands as the Bekanntgabe date. The one-month Einspruch period of § 355 Abs. 1 AO then starts the next day (09.12.2024, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later, on the day with the same number, i.e. Thu 09.01.2025 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 09.01.2025 is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NW, so no further shift applies (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO).

items.title: Refund of overpaid tax to be received
items.quote: Abzüglich der einbehaltenen Lohnsteuer von 5.530,00 € ergibt sich eine Erstattung von 412,00 €, die auf das in der Erklärung genannte Konto überwiesen wird.
items.computation: The letter states a refund of 412,00 € will be transferred to the account given in the tax return, but gives no specific date or deadline for this transfer; such refunds are typically processed within a few weeks of the assessment but no exact date can be derived from the letter's text.

warnings: The letter gives no specific date for when the 412,00 € refund will actually be paid out; if it does not arrive within a reasonable time, contact the Finanzamt using the reference number above.

The IBAN printed in the footer (Musterbank Lüne, DE84 2405 0000 0003 0200 00) is the tax office's own account for payments owed to it; it is not relevant to the refund, which goes to the account already on file from the tax return — do not send any payment to it based on this letter.
